3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I arrived home from work, hung my jacket up, and put my briefcase in the hall.

7.speaker: Monica
7.text: "It's from the Department of Education. Franc's university exam results are in."

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: I looked at the page. Below Franc's name and address, his score was written: 435 points, out of a total of 1000.

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: At the bottom of the letter, the word "Failed" was stamped in red.

14.speaker: Monica
14.text: "All those years of effort, all those private lessons... all down the drain."

15.speaker: Player
15.text: "Maybe it'll be good for him to learn from his mistakes."

18.speaker: Monica
18.text: "This isn't just about Franc, you know. Him failing will reflect badly on you. On us."

19.speaker: Monica
19.text: "No, but he should be back from school soon."

20.speaker: Monica
20.text: "I just don't understand. Franc's a smart boy -- why would he sabotage himself like this?"

21.speaker: Narrator
21.text: I heard a key turning in the front door. Franc stomped in and was about to go straight upstairs when he noticed us both in the living room.

22.speaker: Player_Italic
22.text: Wait for Monica to start the conversation.

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: He took a seat across from us, and I handed him the letter. He started reading it.

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: Franc sat down, and Monica handed him the letter. He started reading it.

29.speaker: Narrator
29.text: He went to the kitchen sink and washed his face. A moment later, he came back.

30.speaker: Franc
30.text: "I never thought this would happen. I'm so sorry."

31.speaker: Player
31.text: "It's my fault. I should have been around to help you study."

32.speaker: Player
32.text: "How could you let us down like this?"

33.speaker: Player
33.text: "You made your mother cry with your actions."

34.speaker: Player
34.text: "It's not the end of the world."

36.speaker: Franc
36.text: "I know, I know, I can't do anything right!"

38.speaker: Player
38.text: "Not so fast. There might be something I can do."

40.speaker: Monica
40.text: "If Alphonso could get his dimwit son into Kingshill University, I'm sure Holsord State would have room for a bright boy like Franc."

45.speaker: Narrator
45.text: Monica went upstairs after Franc and I started reading documents before dinner.

46.speaker: Monica
46.text: "I suppose I need some time as well."

47.speaker: Narrator
47.text: Monica left the living room and I started reading newspapers before dinner.

49.speaker: Narrator
49.text: Monica went upstairs after Franc and I started reading documents before dinner.

53.speaker: Player
53.text: "With enough money, I could get you into Harcard in Arcasia. It's one of the best universities in the world."

55.speaker: Monica
55.text: "Anton! I want him to stay in Sordland."

56.speaker: Franc
56.text: "Mom. I've got to get out and experience the world sometime. And in Arcasia, people might see me as something more than just the president's son."

57.speaker: Monica
57.text: "I still don't like it, but I understand."

58.speaker: Player
58.text: "United People's University in United Contana is free. It also has an excellent medical program."

60.speaker: Franc
60.text: "Not exactly how I was expecting to spend my student years, but anything's better than the military."

61.speaker: Monica
61.text: "This is the future of our boy, Anton. What should we do?"

62.speaker: Player
62.text: "It's been decided. You're going to United Contana, Franc."

69.speaker: Narrator
69.text: Gone were the days when I could expect a warm welcome from my family. Franc was either at school, barricaded in his room or out with friends. Deana spent more and more time at her after-school art classes, and Monica... well, Monica avoided me at all costs.

70.speaker: Narrator
70.text: I awaited my usual welcome from Deana before realizing she was out at one of her art classes. Franc was still at school, and Monica... it had been a long time since she'd come to the door to greet me.

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: I paused, awaiting my usual greeting from my wife and daughter. Deana was out at one of her after-school art classes, I remembered. But where was Monica?

75.speaker: Narrator
75.text: From the living room, I heard a muffled sob.

76.speaker: Narrator
76.text: I entered to find Monica sitting on the sofa, a letter in her hands and a look of despair on her face.

77.speaker: Narrator
77.text: Monica briefly rested her head on my shoulder, then handed me the letter.

81.speaker: Narrator
81.text: Monica pointedly moved a few inches away from me, then handed me the letter.

82.speaker: Monica
82.text: "You know what this means -- he's going to have to join the military. He could die, Anton!"

86.speaker: Monica
86.text: "He did this to get back at you, you know. Maybe if you had been there for him more often..."

95.speaker: Player
95.text: "You're a disappointment to this family, Franc."

99.speaker: Franc
99.text: "Do you think I give a fuck?"

101.speaker: Franc
101.text: "Right, you should've taken a break from running the country to help your loser son!"

102.speaker: Narrator
102.text: Franc looked close to tears. Monica put her hand on his shoulder.

103.speaker: Franc
103.text: "It's all about you, isn't it? You don't care that I bombed the test. You just care how it makes you look!"

104.speaker: Player
104.text: "How dare you speak to your parents that way!"

105.speaker: Player
105.text: "My image doesn't matter. This is your future we're talking about."

106.speaker: Player
106.text: "You're right. The President of Sordland cannot have a failure for a son!"

107.speaker: Narrator
107.text: Monica put her hand on his shoulder. She glared at me.

108.speaker: Narrator
108.text: Monica put her hand on his shoulder.

109.speaker: Monica
109.text: "I know it's been a rough time. But you really should have studied harder, Franc."

112.speaker: Monica
112.text: "It's going to be okay. But you really should have studied harder, Franc."

114.speaker: Player
114.text: "I'm not going to take life lessons from Ewald Alphonso."

121.speaker: Player
121.text: "I am a respected alumnus, it's true."

122.speaker: Player
122.text: "I do have connections to the board."

123.speaker: Player
123.text: "It would be nice to have him closer to home."

127.speaker: Franc
127.text: "I guess it's the army for me, then..."

128.speaker: Franc
128.text: "So, what am I supposed to do now?"

129.speaker: Player
129.text: "Well, there's always military school. But you're the president's son. You still have options."

130.speaker: Player
130.text: "You'll go to military school, of course. It's the only place that will have you."

131.speaker: Narrator
131.text: Monica surprised me with her enthusiasm.

135.speaker: Franc
135.text: "But I failed the exam. This sucks. Are you sure about all of this. Isn't it technically illegal?"

136.speaker: Franc
136.text: "If you're going to abuse your power to get me into a school, I want it to be as far away from this family as possible."

139.speaker: Player
139.text: "No. I won't influence your life. You've got to live with what you've done."

143.speaker: Monica
143.text: "Really? President Anton Rayne suddenly refuses to influence his family members' lives? After banning his wife from politics?"

144.speaker: Player
144.text: "That's beside the point. You were the one who caused that whole deal in the first place."

145.speaker: Monica
145.text: "Come on, Anton. This is the least you can do after what you did to me!"

146.speaker: Player
146.text: "There was more at play there than just you or me or any of us. I have a duty to this nation."

147.speaker: Monica
147.text: "I'm so sorry that duty required you to publicly ridicule me!"

148.speaker: Player
148.text: "Don't change the subject from Franc to you."

153.speaker: Franc
153.text: "I don't want to cause any more trouble than I already have. I'll go to military school."

154.speaker: Franc
154.text: "I don't want to cause any more trouble than I already have. I'll join the army."

155.speaker: Franc
155.text: "I'm sick of this house and I'm sick of both of you. I'll go to military school."

156.speaker: Franc
156.text: "I'm sick of this house and I'm sick of both of you. I'll join the goddamn army."

163.speaker: Monica
163.text: "I understand principles are important. But, Anton, which is more important? Your principles or your son's future?"

164.speaker: Narrator
164.text: Franc ran upstairs to his room.

166.speaker: Player
166.text: "Good. It's time you learned some discipline."

171.speaker: Monica
171.text: "Then I believe you will make the right choice."

177.speaker: Franc
177.text: "If it's so important to you, I'll join the goddamn army. I won't be around to disgrace you any further."

178.speaker: Franc
178.text: "If it's so important to you, I'll go to goddamn military school. I won't be around to disgrace you any further."

182.speaker: Player
182.text: "No, I've made my decision. You're going to military school."

183.speaker: Player
183.text: "No, I've made my decision. You're joining the army."

191.speaker: Franc
191.text: "Great. See you when I come home in a body bag."

192.speaker: Franc
192.text: "All right, Dad. Serves me right for not studying."

193.speaker: Player
193.text: "There's Holsord State, or you could study abroad..."

199.speaker: Player
199.text: "You know how I feel about communists, but United People's University in Contana is free. It also has an excellent medical program."

203.speaker: Player
203.text: "Holsord State University is the right decision after all. [Nepotism]"

204.speaker: Player
204.text: "I won't influence your life, Franc. The military is the right choice."

213.speaker: Player
213.text: "There's also Harcard in Arcasia. It's one of the best universities in the world. With enough money, I could get you in."

217.speaker: Player
217.text: "On second thought, I'd rather send Franc to Harcard in Arcasia." [-2 Personal Wealth]

218.speaker: Player
218.text: "It's been decided. I'll pay for Franc to go to Harcard." [-2 Personal Wealth]

219.speaker: Player
219.text: "On the other hand, United People's University in United Contana is free and has an excellent medical program..."

223.speaker: Player
223.text: "On second thought, I'd rather send Franc to United Contana."

235.speaker: Franc
235.text: "The better to keep me under your thumb at all times."

236.speaker: Franc
236.text: "Thanks so much, Dad. I swear I won't let you down this time."

237.speaker: Franc
237.text: "But fine, I accept. It's better than the army."

238.speaker: Narrator
238.text: Monica let out a long exhale.

239.speaker: Monica
239.text: "What a day! Who's hungry for dinner?"

240.speaker: Narrator
240.text: Monica disappeared to the kitchen; Franc to his room. I went to my office and began making some phone calls.

245.speaker: Franc
245.text: "I don't care. Whichever gets me out of here the fastest!"

246.speaker: Franc
246.text: "Thanks, Dad. Holsord State still would have been my first choice."

248.speaker: Franc
248.text: "But it's your call to make, after the way I messed up."

306.speaker: Player
306.text: "Holsord State University is the right decision after all. It will cost a little extra due to the privatization changes." [-1 Personal Wealth], [Nepotism]

319.speaker: Player
319.text: "No. I won't influence your life. You've got to live with what you've done."

330.speaker: Player
330.text: "Terrific. Holsord State it is, then. Though, It is going to cost us a little bit extra due to the privatization changes. [-1 Personal Wealth], [Nepotism]"

332.speaker: Player
332.text: "Unfortunately, Holsord is a no go. We don't have the money, right now."

333.speaker: Franc
333.text: "All thanks to you and your privatization changes!"

335.speaker: Player
335.text: "No. I won't influence your life. You've got to live with what you've done."

338.speaker: Player
338.text: "No, I've made my decision. I'm sending you to Holsord State. [Nepotism]"

349.speaker: Player
349.text: "You're right. Besides, We don't have the money for Holsord, right now."

351.speaker: Player
351.text: "No, I've made my decision. I'm sending you to Holsord State, even if it is going to cost us a little bit extra due to the privatization changes. [-1 Personal Wealth], [Nepotism]"

353.speaker: Player
353.text: "So, I guess, you've got to live with what you've done."

355.speaker: Franc
355.text: "All thanks to you and your privatization changes!"

361.speaker: Monica
361.text: "This is the future of our boy, Anton. What should we do?"

368.speaker: Franc
368.text: "Holsord State would be amazing! A bunch of my friends are going there, I could still come home to do my laundry."

370.speaker: Player
370.text: "There's nothing for us to decide. Franc's going into the military."
